transcript: == Track transcription == This is Jeff. How can I help you?
I got a two-story tall cannon. I need a few guys to help me wheel this thing in there.
You got... how... uh... what...like a... late eighteen-hundreds?
[slow, pitch down] Yeah it's, uh, got sixty-five thousand pounds and uh...
Wait... Wh- where you at right now with that thing?
[slow, pitch down] This is out of this world... I'm up in the air right now. I'm in a helicopter. Got a...
Oh you're so full of shit.
Why don't you just take a look at this thing? I'm gonna give you a great deal. Smokin' deal!
Well bring it on-... Ca- can- can you get it down here or not?
Where the frig do I land this thing, man?
Where you gonna land it? Huh huh!
(I don't know! Uh, he's got a cannon.)
(Yeah, don't pay me 'til later this week.)
(Yeah.. he's got... it's Leon. He's got a cannon.)
Yeah, you got another thing comin'... once I show up.
(Well, I don't know where we're gonna put it at...)
Tell ya what... I'm gonna blow a few things up and you're gonna love whatcha see. [slow, pitch down] Motorcycle
Do you need me to come up there with a dolly, or... how heavy is... how heavy is this thing?
Well... c-c-... alright... Come on down. '[wails]' I can't go anywhere, I'm doin' a bunch of electrical work right now.
I can blow up a motorcycle...
I can't- I- I- I- I hear you messin' around on the phone sir.
...a barbecue, a [slow, pitch down] pool table, a motorcycle...
Ah... I'm doin' a bunch of electrical work. Just come on down here. I'll be down here, man.
What I'll do is, I'll land, I'll blow up a motorcycle...
I'll let you shoot a few things. And... we can talk hundred dollar bills, whadda' ya think?
Talk to ya when ya get here.
I'm lookin' to stay off the books.
I know. Goodbye. I gotcha. I gotcha...
[slow, pitch down] Come on. big-timer. Come on, alright, let's see whatcha got...
I gotcha. Come on down. Bye. Yep. Later. Gotta go.
I getcha, I getcha. There's just...
...[slow, pitch down] tell me whatcha need, I'm... hook ya up.
You know I go, I go real big.
Uh, uh, I've got a two-story battle cannon.
[heavily distorted] Aw yeah- It's incredibly rare.
Oh, yeah! I was gonna blow up a motorcycle. I've got a...
I've got a dirt bike that, uh... doesn't work. So I'm gonna blow it up so it'll serve...
...it'll serve two purposes. Uh... I need to know where I can land. I'm in a helicopter right now and I'm bringin' you this cannon and it's o-
I'm awful busy right now. Who is this?
I haven't taken off. My name's, uh, Doc from Alamogordo. [slow, pitch down] I'm flyin' around here and I need to know the coordinates to land.
If you could tell me where the...
Where the safest place I could land. Do you wanna discuss this... further, or no?
Not right now. We're too damn busy. We got people everywhere [unintelligible].
I got people lined up to see this thing.
Okay. I believe it. But not with me.
